oil.when: 2010 with the message center SETUP and RESET buttons
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition to ON. The engine does not need to be running.
Press and release SETUP until the message center shows OIL LIFE XXX% HOLD RESET = NEW.
Press and hold RESET for about two seconds, then let go. Oil life goes back to 100%.
oil.note: Tapping RESET while OIL LIFE SET TO XXX% is showing lowers the starting value 10% per tap. Leave it at 100% unless your shop advised otherwise.

tpms.when: 2009 (no reset button: the light clears after driving)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the sticker in the driver's door opening.
Drive above 20 mph for at least two minutes. The light should then go out by itself.
If the tires are set correctly, the spare is not on the car, and the light stays on, have the system checked soon.
tpms.note: The light also stays on while the temporary spare is fitted, until the repaired road tire is back on. If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.
